posts.title: The Micro-Feature Fallacy: How AI Shrinks Scope but Bloats Systems
posts.summary: Cheap AI code generation makes niche features easy to approve. Evaluate their lifetime configuration, compatibility, and support costs before adding a toggle.

posts.title: Architectural Debt is the New Technical Debt
posts.summary: AI can rewrite messy functions in seconds, but quick patches across service boundaries obscure who owns a fact. Guard domain contracts before generating code.

posts.title: Task state is a call stack for agent work
posts.summary: A shared task-state ledger lets you and an AI agent checkpoint tangents, preserve return addresses, and resume the original work after context shifts.

posts.title: The velocity microphone: AI amplifies unclear intent
posts.summary: AI compresses tree-swing failures from weeks into minutes. Durable instructions, scoped authority, automated checks, and human release gates contain the risk.

posts.title: Your sprint plans a bottleneck that left
posts.summary: Story points, dependency arrows, and frozen API contracts were built around slow typing. AI moved that bottleneck, and the plan still points at where it was.

posts.title: The 10x paradox: agentic AI's hidden cognitive tax
posts.summary: Agentic AI made me ten times more productive and deleted the pauses that used to catch my mistakes. Why the friction was a feature, and how to put it back.

posts.title: Security by construction: your code stays on your machine
posts.summary: The threat model behind driving Copilot from your phone: zero code-sync, loopback binds, TOTP on every connection, and a pinned wss hop that fails closed.

posts.title: Deploying the gateway: containers, WSL, and your LAN
posts.summary: Where to run the CloakCode gateway when your editors are spread across a host, dev containers, and WSL — and how to reach it without carelessly binding 0.0.0.0.

posts.title: One phone link for every window — now behind a code
posts.summary: Running several Copilot agents across windows and machines turns your phone into a wallet of QR codes. The CloakCode gateway multiplexes every window into one phone link — and the moment it's exposed beyond loopback, operator TOTP locks it down automatically.

posts.title: Your Copilot agent is waiting for you — and you're not at your desk
posts.summary: Copilot stalls waiting on one approval while you're away — CloakCode mirrors your live session to your phone so you can unblock it with a tap, without your code ever leaving your machine.
